required_link: one official original monthly FT-900 full-report PDF URL for each target month
method: Read the one official HTML index once; extract only its hrefs. Bind an href to a month only if the official index identifies that month unambiguously and its path is within the official FT-900 release directory. Do not invent URLs from a pattern, count annual revisions as months, or infer missing links from a current API history.
stop: If the index cannot be read or does not give 144 unambiguous month-to-PDF bindings, preserve exact bytes/receipt and list the concrete gaps; do not fetch monthly PDFs or fabricate coverage.
